acceptanceCriteria: Either `cem cite` replaces the citation set for the rows a plan names, or DOGFOOD.md step 4 says the map must be deleted before re-citing and the loop prints that instruction.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the fresh-agent leg of V1-0146 (PR #102, extracted v0.7.0 build 46 archive, BASE d18db3d). Step 4: a corrected plan was added to the stale citations; the untracked map had to be deleted by hand before the correct plan took effect.
title: cem cite: citations are added to the untracked map instead of replacing it, so a corrected plan unions with the stale one
